title: Neon Echoes - my first game
author: mrwolf214
selftext:
https://youtu.be/HTYGrHGwAmM?is=qkqcxYS1u3i75KIV

It’s called Neon Echoes. I used Claude and three.js and sprites from Pixellab.ai. It’s a HD2D neo-noir cyberpunkish detective game. It needs work but for a first full game I think it’s interesting. 

Basically the process was that I would play a little, tell Claude what I liked and what I didn’t and ask Claude to change and add stuff.  I was surprised how few tokens using three.js required compared to the other game I tried creating with Unity. Sure it’s not as detailed when using three.js but I only spent about 50 hours over a couple of weeks off and on creating it so I think it looks ok.  Sounds and music were generated by Claude.
